root_cause: ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices is a negative test that intentionally supplies out-of-range index values (0.1 cast to an integer index) expecting the CPU plugin to raise an ov::Exception during inference. All 4 parameterizations (f32/i32 data x i32/i64 index precision) failed because no exception was thrown, meaning the CPU ScatterUpdate implementation currently accepts the out-of-range index silently instead of validating and rejecting it. The triggering commit (#38636, GPU Windows device-ID enumeration) only touches src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/runtime/*, which is unrelated to the CPU ScatterUpdate kernel at src/plugins/intel_cpu/tests/functional/custom/single_layer_tests/scatter_update.cpp:145 and src/plugins/intel_cpu/src/nodes/scatter_update.cpp (the production code under test). This is a pre-existing, known-recurring CPU plugin correctness/flakiness gap (2nd+ occurrence in the pattern database) unrelated to this push's actual diff.
reproduction_steps: Build the CPU plugin functional test binary and run: ./bin/intel64/Release/ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter='*smoke_ScatterUpdateGeneralPathOutOfRangeIndices/ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices*'. Confirm no ov::Exception is thrown for indices_values=(0.1) with axis=0 on IS=[8,4] updates=[2,4] for all f32/i32 x i32/i64 index-precision combinations.
recommended_actions: Review ScatterUpdate CPU kernel bounds-checking in src/plugins/intel_cpu/src/nodes/scatter_update.cpp to ensure out-of-range indices are validated and throw ov::Exception before/while computing the layer.
Check if this out-of-range-index validation was recently removed/regressed, or if it never covered this exact shape/index combination.

If the test's expectation is incorrect (e.g., out-of-range check intentionally deferred to a later validation stage), update ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest accordingly and document the behavior change.
Since this is a recurring (2nd+) pattern, prioritize triage with the CPU plugin owners before the next merge window to avoid repeated red post-commit runs.
prevention_strategies: Add bounds/range validation unit tests at the op level (not just layer tests) for ScatterUpdate index inputs, and gate merges on these tests passing with gtest_repeat>1 to catch intermittent gaps. Track this specific test's health via the CI Doctor pattern (c7d3b823733ac934) and escalate if it recurs again.
historical_context: This exact failure signature (c7d3b823733ac934) has now been recorded 3 times: first seen 2026-11-13, then 2026-11-16, and now 2026-11-17 across different post-commit runs, always on master and consistently on the same 4 ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices parameterizations. None of the past triggering commits touched the CPU ScatterUpdate code, confirming this is an independent, persistent gap in CPU plugin exception handling rather than a one-off regression from any single commit.
